Book a basketball trial in Copenhagen

From age 5 up. Some kids have never touched a ball, some are chasing a scholarship, and both have a place here. You see your first session the moment you register, and we answer every registration ourselves.

Mini and Junior: Tue + Thu at Strandvejsskolen, Sat at Kulturhuset Indre By. Academy: Monday to Friday. Sparks: Monday at Strandvejsskolen.

Book a trial See the programs

How to join

Most of our programs have no tryout. Fill in the form below and you see your first session straight away, with the group your child would join. After the trial Deng tells you which program fits and sends the Holdsport link. Membership starts when you join a team there, and there is no long contract.

Programs

Same coaching staff across all of them. Which one suits you depends on age and how much you want to train.

Academy

For players who want to take it seriously. Video review, shooting machines, and coaches who have walked the road to college ball in North America.

  • Up to five days a week, Monday to Friday
  • Video analysis and feedback
  • Scholarship pathway support
  • Ages 13 to 19
  • Application required
Book a trial

Teams

Most of the kids in this group had never played before they came. Turn up and you are in.

  • No experience needed
  • 2 to 3 sessions per week
  • League games from U13
  • Ages 5 to adult

Development

One coach, one player. We work out what is holding you back and spend the hour on that. Booked around your schedule.

  • Flexible scheduling

Questions

How much does membership cost?

Per half season: Mini and Junior 1.800 kr. Sparks 1.200 kr on its own, 1.800 kr with a weekday session. Academy 3.300 kr, which covers up to five sessions a week. Talata Men and Talata & Co. 2.000 kr. Ask us about the sibling discount. You pay only once you decide to join. If the fee is hard, talk to us. A child under 18 living in Københavns Kommune can get up to 1.000 kr toward the fee and 500 kr for kit, and we do the application.

What age groups do you have?

Mini is 5 to 9, Junior is 10 to 12, and Academy runs U13 through U19 (ages 13 to 19). Talata Sparks is girls only, ages 6 to 14. Girls 15 and up train with the Stevnsgade girls team, coached by Jordan. Men 18 and up can play for Talata Men, and men and women 18 and up for Talata & Co.

Junior: Tue + Thu 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By.
Sparks: Mon 15:30 to 16:30 at Strandvejsskolen.
Academy U13 and U15: Mon 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen, Mon 16:45 to 18:45 at Svanemøllehallen, Tue + Wed 16:00 to 18:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By, Thu 17:00 to 19:00 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 16:00 to 18:00 at Bellahøj Hallerne.
Academy U17: Mon 16:45 to 18:45 at Svanemøllehallen, Tue + Wed 16:00 to 18:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By, Thu 17:00 to 19:00 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 16:00 to 18:00 at Bellahøj Hallerne.
Academy U19: Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Thu 18:00 to 19:00 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole.
Girls 15 and up (Stevnsgade girls team): Mon + Wed + Fri 17:30 to 19:00 at Nørrebrohallen.
Talata Men: Mon 18:45 to 20:15 at Svanemøllehallen, Fri 18:45 to 21:00 at Nørre Fælled Skole.

How do we join after the trial?

Through Holdsport, our team app. You create a profile in the player's name, then parents get added to the child. Holdsport is in Danish: Log på means log in, Opret ny profil means create a new profile. Joining a team there starts your membership fee, so only do it once you have decided. We send you the link. New to Holdsport? Step by step guide.

My child is serious about basketball. Is this the right club?

Talata players have moved on to prep school in Canada and high school basketball in Ohio and New Jersey. The Academy runs up to five sessions a week with film sessions, shooting machines and scholarship pathway support. Deng played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, and he knows the path.

Can I watch a session before registering?

Yes. Register below first so we can tell you which session fits and set aside time for you. Academy sessions to watch are Monday and Thursday at Svanemøllehallen. Mini and Junior are Tuesday and Thursday at Strandvejsskolen.

Joining a team on Holdsport starts your membership.

Holdsport is where we run the club. Teams, attendance, payments, all of it. The half-season fee below is charged the moment you join a team there. If you have never been in the gym with us, come to a trial first.
